name: What is luxury seller representation and how does it differ from standard real estate services?

mainEntity.name: What is luxury seller representation and how does it differ from standard real estate services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury seller representation is a specialized real estate service focused on properties typically valued above a certain threshold, often involving unique marketing strategies and a deep understanding of the high-end market. It differs from standard services by offering tailored marketing, discretion, and negotiation expertise specific to affluent buyers and distinctive properties. For properties in Miami-Dade or Palm Beach County, this often includes international marketing channels, professional staging advice, and targeted outreach to high-net-worth individuals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury seller representation provides specialized marketing, discretion, and negotiation expertise for high-value properties, differing from standard services by targeting affluent buyers with tailored strategies.
